A bot does it, not a person. Every trade’s 3% tax collects in the token contract; once it reaches the contract’s threshold, the contract swaps it to BNB and sends it to the buyback wallet. A bot on Cloudflare Workers runs every 10 minutes, around the clock, and splits what came in by the schedule in force: it buys and burns $BOBAI (and $BOB until Dec 1, 2026), adds liquidity and burns the LP, pays the creator share and, until Nov 20, 2026, funds the DeFi agent and the Giggle Academy pot.
